courses.synopsis: Diet as therapeutic tool. Drugs and physical therapy. Abnormalities of the GI tract. Therapeutic diets. Diseases of the liver, etc. classification of diets, ulcer diet, diabetic diet, or according to consistency or according to nutrients, high protein, high calories, low protein etc. general principles of diet preparation, personal hygiene, kitchen hygiene etc. Use of food composition to prepare diet, to understand human senses, gestation, taste a small receptors, organoleptic assessment. Statistical interpretation of data.
